title: The research network: who publishes with Exponent
what: A map of the corporations that have co-authored research with Exponent scientists. Bigger circles = more joint publications.
how: Built from the same OpenAlex publication data: each circle is a company whose name appeared alongside an Exponent affiliation on at least one paper; the line thickness reflects how many.
thesis: The names matter as much as the count: medical-device makers (Stryker, Alcon), chemical/energy majors (Dow, ExxonMobil), consumer giants (P&G), utilities (PG&E) - blue-chip, litigation-exposed, R&D-heavy companies. That's the exact client profile that supports premium pricing and repeat engagement.
caveats: Being on a paper together confirms a research relationship, not necessarily a paid consulting engagement (though for a consultancy the overlap is high).
Hover any circle for details; drag to explore. The table view lists every company.
